case.title: New stainless pump shaft SH-220: award one of two suppliers
case.briefing: The new PX pump series needs shaft SH-220 (1.4021). Two suppliers quote: a German job shop and a Polish machining company. Lead time must not exceed 42 days; the line needs parts within 35 days, every day later costs EUR 150. Machined shafts are a leverage category: several capable suppliers, the goal is the lowest total cost. Award one.

move.subject: SH-220: revised pricing and delivery proposal
move.body:
Dear Ms Kaczmarek,

Thank you for your proposal. Offer:DEMO-C1-0 quotes €16.00 per shaft; could you provide a breakdown of material, machining and logistics costs?

Offer:DEMO-C1-0 specifies a standard lead time of 45 days; what is the earliest repeatable lead time you can commit to?

Please consider the two packages below. We can offer faster payment in exchange for a lower unit price. Could consolidated shipments or a different production schedule reduce your costs further without changing the shaft specification?

Please confirm which package you can support.

Best regards,
Hollerau Pumpenwerke Purchasing

move.text:
Dear partner,

We have reviewed your offer and can adjust our Angebot as follows. We appreciate your alternative proposals and are pleased to build on your second package with 30-day payment terms and FCA delivery.

For this configuration, our offer is a price of €16.20 per unit, Zahlungsziel 30 days net, Lieferzeit 35 days, delivery FCA. For this configuration, including the reduced 35-day lead time, we can offer a revised price of €16.20 per unit.

To help us evaluate potential cost reductions through different production schedules, could you share specific data on your expected order volumes? Which volume can you commit to? Material accounts for about 45 % of our cost; more detail we do not share.

Please note that our offer stays valid for 30 days.

Best regards
Joanna Kaczmarek
Export Manager, Demo Machining Sp. z o.o.

move.subject: SH-220: volume planning and revised packages
move.body:
Dear Ms Kaczmarek,

Offer:DEMO-C1-0 lists 6,000 pieces annually; we can support that volume with regular monthly releases under the fixed two-year agreement.

Offer:DEMO-C1-1 quotes €16.20 per shaft; could predictable releases and consolidated machining batches support a lower price?

We have modestly increased our proposed prices in the packages below. The FCA package retains your requested payment terms; the DAP package offers a higher price for delivered supply.

Which package can you support, and would a different release pattern reduce machining or transport costs further?

Best regards,
Hollerau Pumpenwerke Purchasing

move.text:
Dear partner,

We appreciate your confirmation of the 6,000 pieces annual volume and regular monthly releases, which allows us to optimize our machining batches. Consolidated batches do support our production efficiency, and this benefit is fully reflected in our revised proposal. 

In response to this commitment and your improved offer, we are pleased to reduce our price to €16.10 per unit for the FCA package with 30-day payment terms. Our current Angebot features a price of €16.10 per unit, Zahlungsziel 30 days net, Lieferzeit 35 days, delivery FCA. Please note that our price follows our main cost drivers: BAR-14021, WAGES-METAL. This Angebot remains valid for 30 days.

Best regards
Joanna Kaczmarek

messages.body:
Dear Ms Kaczmarek,

Thank you for your proposal. Offer:DEMO-C1-0 quotes €16.00 per shaft; could you provide a breakdown of material, machining and logistics costs?

Offer:DEMO-C1-0 specifies a standard lead time of 45 days; what is the earliest repeatable lead time you can commit to?

Please confirm which package you can support.

Best regards,
Hollerau Pumpenwerke Purchasing

messages.from_name: Export Manager, Demo Machining Sp. z o.o.
messages.subject: Re: SH-220: revised pricing and delivery proposal
messages.body:
Dear partner,

We have reviewed your offer and can adjust our Angebot as follows. We appreciate your alternative proposals and are pleased to build on your second package with 30-day payment terms and FCA delivery.

For this configuration, our offer is a price of €16.20 per unit, Zahlungsziel 30 days net, Lieferzeit 35 days, delivery FCA. For this configuration, including the reduced 35-day lead time, we can offer a revised price of €16.20 per unit.

To help us evaluate potential cost reductions through different production schedules, could you share specific data on your expected order volumes? Which volume can you commit to? Material accounts for about 45 % of our cost; more detail we do not share.

Please note that our offer stays valid for 30 days.

Best regards
Joanna Kaczmarek
Export Manager, Demo Machining Sp. z o.o.
